summary.text: Overture Walker is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 22 in Richland County.
He is an attorney and previously chaired the Richland County Council in 2022 and 2023.

paragraphs.text: Walker was born on September 30, 1980, at Shaw Air Force Base.
His official page lists a B.A. from the University of South Carolina in 2002 and a J.D. in 2004.
He was an assistant public defender in Richland County in 2005 and 2006, then city prosecutor and assistant city attorney in Columbia from 2006 to 2008, and has been in private practice since 2009.
He served as a Columbia municipal court judge from 2015 to 2020 and on the Richland County Council from 2021 to 2024, chairing it in 2022 and 2023.
His Senate committees are Corrections and Penology, Judiciary, Rules and Transportation.
